new_coverage: Defender multi-pointer and touch/mouse/pen ownership, direction reversal and committed-dive isolation
Portrait/landscape layout changes during a held touch retain a stationary attacker and a single commit
Hidden pause rejects extra input, excludes hidden time and accepts a fresh touch after the old release
Home and mode change replace gesture elements; retired same-ID handlers cannot affect the next scene
limits: Node integration tests use real application handlers, Match/Shot and Stadium with controlled DOM, storage, RAF and renderer stubs
Layout bounds simulate orientation changes; no real browser/phone rotation, GPU or touchscreen claim
Retired pointer events target a replaced element; no impossible same-element recycled-pointer ordering is assumed
